multisig.note: Vault wallet type: m-of-n (default 2-of-3); person can generate or import several keys in the app

hw_signer.note: Imports Coldcard/Cobo/Keystone-style keys by QR or file and signs via PSBT QR or file; no USB, Bluetooth or NFC link

psbt.note: Unsigned PSBT shows as animated QR, file or clipboard; signed PSBT is scanned or opened from a file

watch_only.note: Imports xpub/ypub/zpub, single-key descriptors or one address as watch-only; shows balance and history

passphrase.note: Passphrase prompt only when importing a seed or adding a multisig seed key; creating a new wallet offers none

coin_control.note: Coin Control screen selects UTXOs and hands them to Send; coins can also be frozen

fee_bump.note: RBF bump, RBF cancel and CPFP exist, but allowRBF() is true only for native SegWit (and aezeed) wallets

taproot.note: Taproot (BIP86) is a wallet-type choice in Add Wallet; receive addresses are bc1p; default type is native SegWit

descriptors.note: Imports wpkh/sh/pkh/tr and sortedmulti descriptors; exports a descriptor (tr()) only for Taproot wallets

own_server.note: Electrum server setting takes any host and TCP/SSL port after a connection test; defaults are a hardcoded peer list

verifies_chain.note: Balances and history are taken straight from Electrum replies; headers are fetched only for timestamps, no proofs

tor.note: .onion Electrum hosts are accepted; no Tor in the app, the error text asks the person to connect the Orbot app

seed_standard.note: New on-chain wallets get a 12-word BIP39 phrase (16 bytes of entropy), shown on a backup screen

cloud_backup.note: Wallet data saved in a this-device-only keychain item and Realm excluded from iCloud backup; only manual seed display
